Valuations that previously commanded rich forward price-to-earnings multiples are being rigorously tested against the prevailing risk-free benchmark yield. Asset allocators are increasingly executing barbell strategies—pairing short-duration sovereign paper with high-conviction equity positions backed by tangible return on invested capital.

With macroeconomic cross-currents elevated, asset managers emphasize strict capital preservation protocols, prioritizing balance sheets that demonstrate unencumbered collateral buffers, robust interest coverage ratios (ICR), and transparent capital allocation discipline.
